+@dataclass

+        except OSError:

+    def is_directory(self) -> bool:
+        if self.is_link() and not self.dereference:
+            return False
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISDIR(self.metadata().st_mode)
+        except OSError:

+    def is_file(self) -> bool:

+        except OSError:

+            return int(getattr(self.metadata(), "st_file_attributes", 0))

+def display_width(text: str) -> int:
+    width = 0
+    for char in text:
+        if unicodedata.combining(char):
+            continue
+        width += 2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(char) in ("W", "F") else 1
+    return width

+def escaped(text: str) -> str:
+    replacements = {
+        "\n": r"\n",
+        "\r": r"\r",
+        "\t": r"\t",
+        "\x1b": r"\e",
+    }
+    bits = []
+    for char in text:
+        if char in replacements:
+            bits.append(replacements[char])
+        elif ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127:
+            bits.append(f"\\x{ord(char):02x}")
+        else:
+            bits.append(char)
+    return "".join(bits)

+def quote(text: str, no_quotes: bool = False) -> str:
+    text = escaped(text)
+    if no_quotes or not any(char.isspace() for char in text):
+        return text
+    return "'" + text.replace("'", "\\'") + "'"

+def explicit_display_path(entry: Entry, cfg: Config) -> str:

+        return quote(result, cfg.no_quotes)
+    if entry.parent_dir is not None:
+        return quote(entry.name, cfg.no_quotes)
+    parent = os.path.dirname(entry.path)
+    if not parent:
+        return quote(entry.name, cfg.no_quotes)
+    return quote(parent, cfg.no_quotes) + os.sep + quote(entry.name, cfg.no_quotes)

+def natural_key(text: str, upper_first: bool = False):
+    parts = re.split(r"(\d+)", text)
+    key = []
+    for part in parts:
+        if part.isdigit():
+            key.append((0, int(part), len(part)))
+        else:
+            key.append((1, part if upper_first else part.casefold()))
+    return tuple(key)

+def extension_of(name: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    position = name.rfind(".")
+    return None if position < 0 else name[position + 1 :].lower()

+def entry_sort_key(entry: Entry, cfg: Config):
+    field_name = cfg.sort_field
+    if field_name == "none":
+        return 0
+    if field_name in ("name", "hidden-name"):
+        name = entry.name
+        if field_name == "hidden-name" and name.startswith("."):
+            name = name[1:]
+        return natural_key(name, cfg.sort_upper_first)
+    if field_name == "extension":
+        extension = extension_of(entry.name)
+        if extension is None:
+            return (0, (), natural_key(entry.name, cfg.sort_upper_first))
+        return (
+            1,
+            natural_key(extension, cfg.sort_upper_first),
+            natural_key(entry.name, cfg.sort_upper_first),
+        )
+    if field_name == "size":
+        size = entry.size()
+        return (-1 if size is None else size)
+    if field_name == "type":
+        return (entry.type_rank(), natural_key(entry.name, False))
+    if field_name == "age":
+        return -(entry.time_ns("modified") or 0)
+    if field_name in ("modified", "accessed", "created", "changed"):
+        return entry.time_ns(field_name) or 0
+    return natural_key(entry.name, False)

+def sort_entries(entries: list[Entry], cfg: Config) -> list[Entry]:
+    if cfg.sort_field != "none":
+        entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda item: entry_sort_key(item, cfg))
+    if cfg.reverse:
+        entries.reverse()
+    if cfg.dirs_first:
+        entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda item: not item.points_to_directory())
+    elif cfg.dirs_last:
+        entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda item: item.points_to_directory())
+    return entries

+def ignored(name: str, cfg: Config) -> bool:
+    return any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, pattern) for pattern in cfg.ignore_patterns)

+def hidden_entry(entry: Entry) -> bool:
+    if entry.name.startswith((".", "_")):
+        return True
+    return bool(entry.attributes() & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN)

+def child_passes(entry: Entry, cfg: Config, *, recursing: bool) -> bool:
+    if ignored(entry.name, cfg):
+        return False
+    only_dirs = cfg.only_dirs
+    only_files = cfg.only_files
+    no_links = cfg.no_symlinks
+    show_links = cfg.show_symlinks
+    if only_dirs and not only_files:
+        if show_links:
+            return entry.is_directory() or entry.points_to_directory()
+        return entry.is_directory()
+    if only_files and not only_dirs:
+        if recursing:
+            return True
+        if show_links:
+            return entry.is_file() or (entry.is_link() and not entry.points_to_directory())
+        return entry.is_file()
+    if no_links and not show_links:
+        return not entry.is_link()
+    return True

+def scan_directory(path: str, cfg: Config, *, recursing: bool) -> tuple[list[Entry], Optional[OSError]]:
+    entries: list[Entry] = []
+    if cfg.show_dots:
+        entries.append(Entry(path, ".", path, True, cfg.dereference))
+        entries.append(Entry(os.path.join(path, ".."), "..", path, True, cfg.dereference))
+    try:
+        with os.scandir(path) as iterator:
+            for item in iterator:
+                entry = make_entry(item.path, path, item.name, cfg=cfg)
+                if not cfg.show_hidden and hidden_entry(entry):
+                    continue
+                if child_passes(entry, cfg, recursing=recursing):
+                    entries.append(entry)
+    except OSError as error:
+        return [], error
+    return sort_entries(entries, cfg), None

+def grid_lines(cells: Sequence[str], width: int, across: bool, gap: int = 2) -> list[str]:
+    if not cells:
+        return []
+    count = len(cells)
+    chosen_rows = count
+    chosen_cols = 1
+    chosen_widths = [max(display_width(cell) for cell in cells)]
+
+    for rows in range(1, count + 1):
+        cols = math.ceil(count / rows)
+        widths = [0] * cols
+        for index, cell in enumerate(cells):
+            if across:
+                col = index % cols
+            else:
+                col = index // rows
+            widths[col] = max(widths[col], display_width(cell))
+        total = sum(widths) + gap * (cols - 1)
+        if total <= width or cols == 1:
+            chosen_rows, chosen_cols, chosen_widths = rows, cols, widths
+            break
+
+    output: list[str] = []
+    for row in range(chosen_rows):
+        row_cells: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
+        for col in range(chosen_cols):
+            index = row * chosen_cols + col if across else col * chosen_rows + row
+            if index < count:
+                row_cells.append((col, cells[index]))
+        if not row_cells:
+            continue
+        bits: list[str] = []
+        for cell_index, (col, cell) in enumerate(row_cells):
+            bits.append(cell)
+            if cell_index < len(row_cells) - 1:
+                padding = chosen_widths[col] - display_width(cell) + gap
+                bits.append(" " * padding)
+        output.append("".join(bits))
+    return output
+

+def formatted_size(entry: Entry, mode: str) -> str:
+    size = entry.size()
+    if size is None:
+        return "-"
+    if mode == "bytes":
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    base = 1024 if mode == "binary" else 1000
+    symbols = ("", "Ki", "Mi", "Gi", "Ti", "Pi", "Ei") if mode == "binary" else ("", "k", "M", "G", "T", "P", "E")
+    if size < base:
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    exponent = min(int(math.log(size, base)), len(symbols) - 1)
+    number = size / (base**exponent)
+    rendered = f"{number:.1f}" if number < 10 else f"{math.floor(number + 0.5):,}"
+    return rendered + symbols[exponent]

+def fixed_local_datetime(timestamp_ns: int) -> tuple[dt.datetime, dt.timedelta]:
+    timestamp = timestamp_ns / 1_000_000_000
+    utc = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp, dt.timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
+    offset = dt.datetime.now().astimezone().utcoffset() or dt.timedelta(0)
+    return utc + offset, offset
+

+def relative_time(value: dt.datetime) -> str:
+    now = dt.datetime.now()
+    seconds = max(0, int((now - value).total_seconds()))
+    ranges = (
+        (365 * 86400, "year"),
+        (30 * 86400, "month"),
+        (7 * 86400, "week"),
+        (86400, "day"),
+        (3600, "hour"),
+        (60, "minute"),
+    )
+    for divisor, label in ranges:
+        if seconds >= divisor:
+            amount = max(1, math.floor(seconds / divisor + 0.5))
+            return f"{amount} {label}{'' if amount == 1 else 's'}"
+    return "now"
+
+
+def chrono_custom(value: dt.datetime, pattern: str) -> str:
+    pattern = pattern.replace("%_d", "{EZA_DAY}").replace("%f", "{EZA_NANO}")
+    output = value.strftime(pattern)
+    output = output.replace("{EZA_DAY}", f"{value.day:2d}")
+    output = output.replace("{EZA_NANO}", f"{value.microsecond * 1000:09d}")
+    return output
+
+
+def formatted_time(entry: Entry, kind: str, style: str) -> str:
+    timestamp_ns = entry.time_ns(kind)
+    if timestamp_ns is None:
+        return "-"
+    value, offset = fixed_local_datetime(timestamp_ns)
+    current_year = dt.datetime.now().year
+    if style == "default":
+        if value.year == current_year:
+            return f"{value.day:2d} {value.strftime('%b')} {value:%H:%M}"
+        return f"{value.day:2d} {value.strftime('%b')}  {value:%Y}"
+    if style == "iso":
+        return value.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M" if value.year == current_year else "%Y-%m-%d")
+    if style == "long-iso":
+        return value.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
+    if style == "full-iso":
+        total_minutes = int(offset.total_seconds() // 60)
+        sign = "+" if total_minutes >= 0 else "-"
+        total_minutes = abs(total_minutes)
+        zone = f"{sign}{total_minutes // 60:02d}{total_minutes % 60:02d}"
+        nanos = timestamp_ns % 1_000_000_000
+        return value.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") + f".{nanos:09d} {zone}"
+    if style == "relative":
+        return relative_time(value)
+    if style.startswith("+"):
+        formats = style[1:].split("\n")
+        pattern = formats[1] if len(formats) > 1 and value.year == current_year else formats[0]
+        return chrono_custom(value, pattern)
+    return formatted_time(entry, kind, "default")
